Hex Editor · In development

Hex editor

View and edit any file as bytes. Saved to Files.

Open now

Hex Editor has these main features: Offset, hex and ASCII columns, with undo and redo; Find bytes or text, and go to any offset.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with Hex Editor

  • View a file in hex
  • Identify a file by its magic bytes
